title: NMT History of Ukraine tests
description: This mod adds a collection of NMT History of Ukraine tests. After you answer a question, it reveals the correct response and gives you either a penalty or a reward.
body:
This mod adds a collection of NMT History of Ukraine tests. After you answer a question, it reveals the correct response and gives you either a penalty or a reward.

You can also connect a Groq API key to get an AI-generated explanation of the correct answer at the end of each question. (**AI-generated explanations might be inaccurate or contain errors!**) This is an optional feature; the mod will still work and show the correct answers without an API key, but it won’t provide explanations.

Images may sometimes fail to load. If this happens, you can click the link below the image to open it in your browser.

Commands:
    /nmtquiz interval — set the number of seconds between questions
    /nmtquiz now — ask a question immediately
    /nmtquiz setkey — set your API key

Hold Tab to see the time remaining until the next question.
If you accidentally closed a question by pressing Esc, you can skip it with the command "/nmtquiz skip" or reopen it using "/nmtmenu"


Data credits: The database for this mod was sourced from: https://github.com/NLPForUA/ZNO/blob/main/tests/history_raw.json
